title: Returning a designated answer
statement: Let $x$ be a finite bit string, let $b$ be a Boolean value, and let $v$ assign natural numbers to $13$ registers, each at most $4(|x|+1)$. Starting in the answer state labelled $b$ with register values $v$ and no answer recorded, the multiplication machine halts with answer $b$.
hypotheses_covered: Every register value is at most $4(|x|+1)$
